segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin mostly report the cream is lightweight, non-greasy and balancing, though one combination/oily reviewer found it too thick and heavy and broke out.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report significant relief, describing dry patches becoming softer, smoother and hydrated, with one calling it a 'blessing to dry skin.'
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: several say it hydrates the dry T-zone well without feeling greasy on oilier areas, but one with dry-T-zone/oily-cheeks combination sensitive skin says it clogged pores and caused a breakout.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers repeatedly praise the fragrance-free formula as non-irritating, non-stinging and non-reddening, calling it one of the few creams that doesn't bother their skin.
segments.mature: The few mature-skin mentions describe it as suited to skin showing early wrinkles and dryness, with one 35-year-old reporting good absorption and no oily after-feel.

concerns.aging: One 35-year-old reviewer noticing first wrinkles and dryness reports the cream feels good and absorbs fast without leaving oiliness; another mature-skin reviewer just calls it good for mature skin generally, so evidence is limited but positive.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe visibly and severely dehydrated skin becoming more even, plump and hydrated within about two weeks; one dissenting first-timer felt it only lasted 48 hours instead of the claimed 72 and absorbed slowly.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness say the cream hydrates without triggering or worsening it, describing it as calming for reactive skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer using retinol reports the cream helps restore her moisture barrier on nights she uses it; another with psoriasis-prone, cracked skin says it leaves her face plump and hydrated all day.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone or blemish-concerned reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement in clarity, but two reviewers explicitly state it broke them out all over the face and one combination-sensitive reviewer says it clogged pores and caused a breakout.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers with oily or previously-oily skin say the cream absorbs quickly, feels light and non-greasy, and even helped 'balance' overproduction of oil, though one combination-skin reviewer found it too heavy and greasy for her cheeks.

aspects.libelle: Residual chemical-like smell despite fragrance-free claim

extraits.titre: Too thick and greasy, made my face break out
extraits.texte: I tried the Mineral 89 Fragrance Free Cream and I am not a fan. The consistency is too thick and made me feel like I was putting goop on my face. It left my face feeling just greasy and heavy, the very next day I had a horrible breakout all over my face. I don't typically leave negative reviews, but I am just not a fan. I have combination skin (dry in my T zone and oily on my cheeks (complete opposite of most people) that is quite sensitive. While I didn't have a negative reaction (no burning, stinging, etc...) this cream clogged my pores and caused breakouts. I would not buy this and I would not personally use this agan. I'm sure that someone out there would love this cream, but it is just not for me.

My skin desperately needed this. This moisturizer absorbs right in making you feel super soft without feeling like you have a heavy layer of film on top of your skin. I do have combination skin with an oily t-zone. This is NOT for oilier skin types imo but is wonderful in the dryer areas.

I found that my skin was severely dehydrated and this product helped me notice this. After using for about 2 weeks I noticed that my skin seemed so much more even and hydrated will definitely be buying more . And I like that there is no fragrance which would've irritated my sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: I will be purchasing this product AGAIN
extraits.texte: *I received this product for free in exchange for writing the review* This moisturizer is very lightweight on my skin, I love that my skin doesn't feel greasy after it's applied. I have very oily skin and I feel like it really balanced that out. I have been using it every night for about a week and my skin looks and feels amazing. I included a few photos you can see how my skin looked the first night I started vs last night!

The Mineral 89 Fragrance Free Cream is what I have been looking for in a moisturizer. It has a medium thickness water like texture, that just melts into the skin. Great for all skin types even oily skin like mine, since it provides a lot of hydration in one thin layer! No scent obviously which is amazing since I have acne prone skin which can be irritated sometimes due to heavily-fragranced products. This moisturizer is unique because it has Pure Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin B3, Vitamin E, and Squalene. These ingredients make it perfect to restore my moisture barrier on the nights I use retinol. I love how lightweight and how my skin drinks this up like water. I will definitely purchase this once I finish the bottle.

extraits.titre: Very good cream for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I have a very sensitive skin so I always use fragrance free creams. Also I'm 35, and I started noticing dry skin and wrinkles. This cream feels great, and I love that is fragance free. It absorbs fast and doesn't leave your skin feeling oily or sticky. I'd recommend for sure

Yes, I know the packaging isn't sexy or exciting. And no, this product probably isn't trending on Tiktok at the moment. However, this is one of the absolute best and most luxurious face creams I've ever used, and at a desirable price point. It leaves my cracked, painful and psoriasis-prone face plump, dewy, glowy and hydrated for the entire day or night. It performs better than the majority of my high end brand creams do and is extremely gentle. Highly recommend trying.
